rules.rule: Merge changes into main only when the user explicitly says to.
Ask the user for approval before downloading and launching a real VS Code instance for a probe.
Do not invoke the `canvas-component-builder` agent or the `/new-component` skill.
Do not stage, commit, or push changes even if it seems like a natural next step.
Do not reconnect acmevintagesupply.com in Shopify → Domains, because it overwrites GoDaddy DNS records.
Never stage `src/data` in a commit to JD-2207/CSI-ISAC.
Never stage `src/checkpoint` in a commit to JD-2207/CSI-ISAC.
Never stage `src/results` in a commit to JD-2207/CSI-ISAC.
Ask for or wait for user approval before running git commit.
